product: Governed tag propagation supports classic compute (Beta)
tagline: Governed tag propagation now supports classic compute running Databricks Runtime 19 or above, in addition to serverless compute.
what_it_does: Governed tag propagation now supports classic compute running Databricks Runtime 19 or above, in addition to serverless compute. Governed tags on a source propagate to the tables and views derived from it on either type of compute. Beta This feature is in Beta.
why_it_matters: Governed tag propagation now supports classic compute running Databricks Runtime 19 or above, in addition to serverless compute.
plain_summary: Governed tag propagation now supports classic compute running Databricks Runtime 19 or above, in addition to serverless compute. Governed tags on a source propagate to the tables and views derived from it on either type of compute.
key_takeaway: Governed tag propagation now supports classic compute running Databricks Runtime 19 or above, in addition to serverless compute.
